title: Ohio Cannabis Ecosystem Directory
description: A source-verified directory of organizations operating in or serving the Ohio cannabis market: operators, service providers and nonprofits, categorized with capability keywords for problem-oriented search. Each record carries the source used to verify it and the seed source recording how it entered the dataset. Organizations that close, merge or rename are retained out of scope rather than deleted, so historical references remain resolvable. This release contains 564 records: 518 in-scope organizations across 16 categories and 46 retained out-of-scope records. Release 4.21 repairs phone links, updates offline intake, adds shareable searches and organization links, and publishes a searchable view of all 60 documented business relationships. Review dates are recorded separately when established by the research history.
